categories.main_business_segments: The company is a high-tech enterprise specializing in automotive interior components research, development, production and sales. It operates as an integrated solution provider covering product design, mold development and manufacturing, component molding, surface coating, appearance wrapping and product assembly. Main business segments include functional components (air conditioning vents, cup holders, storage boxes, door handles, ceiling handles), decorative components (door panels, instrument panels, console panels, trim strips), lightweight components (ventilation ducts), and exterior functional components (active grille shutters, electric charging ports, semi-hidden door handles). The company also has a subsidiary focused on embedded molding for automotive electric drive and control systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including injection molding, blow molding, coating, wrapping, and embedded molding processes. Core technologies include DFMA (Design for Manufacturing and Assembly) methodology, intelligent assembly tooling systems, lightweight composite material technology, fourth-generation intelligent injection molding systems, automated spray coating production lines with environmental protection features, and flexible automated assembly lines. The company has implemented MES (Manufacturing Execution System) for production management and digital transformation across design, mold development, molding, coating, wrapping and assembly processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major domestic automakers such as Chery, Great Wall, BYD, Li Auto, and new energy vehicle manufacturers including Nio, XPeng, and Xiaomi. The company also supplies to global tier-1 suppliers including Yanfeng Automotive Trim Systems, Marelli, Magna, and others, indirectly serving OEMs like Nissan, Geely, Mazda, GAC Aion, Changan, Honda, and Toyota. International markets include North America through partnerships with major customers and tier-1 suppliers. The company serves both traditional fuel vehicle and new energy vehicle markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major production facilities in Wuhu (headquarters), Wuhan, Dalian, Chongqing, Tianjin, and Guangdong. International operations include subsidiaries in Japan (Foresight Technology Co., Ltd.), Hong Kong (Foresight Technology Hong Kong Limited), and Mexico (Foresight Mexico Limited Liability Company). The Mexico facility serves North American markets and achieved 85% capacity utilization in 2024. The company also maintains sales and service teams in Europe and is expanding into emerging markets including India, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the automotive supply chain. It functions as a Tier-1 or Tier-2 supplier, providing integrated interior component solutions directly to major automakers and to tier-1 suppliers who supply OEMs. The company controls the complete value chain from product design and mold development through manufacturing, coating, wrapping, and assembly, positioning it as a comprehensive solution provider rather than a simple component manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) advancing new energy vehicle component development with focus on lightweight and environmentally-friendly materials; (2) developing intelligent and smart surface technologies including touch-sensitive and illuminated interior components; (3) expanding global operations particularly in North America and emerging markets; (4) enhancing digital transformation and smart manufacturing capabilities; (5) strengthening core technology development in areas like high-voltage platform components and integrated electronic systems; (6) deepening collaboration with leading OEMs on synchronized development. R&D investment maintains above 5% of revenue annually, with focus on smart surfaces, low-carbon materials, and modular platform development.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of automotive interior components to OEMs and tier-1 suppliers. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of products, typically upon customer receipt and confirmation. The company operates on a direct sales model with framework contracts, where specific product development is completed and confirmed by customers before production and delivery. Revenue streams include functional components, decorative components, lightweight components, and embedded molding products. The company also generates minor rental income from operating leases.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global automotive interior suppliers including Yanfeng Automotive Trim Systems, Marelli, Magna, and other international tier-1 suppliers. Domestically, it competes with other Chinese automotive component manufacturers. The company positions itself as a technology-leading, quality-focused supplier with advantages in integrated solutions, precision manufacturing, and global supply chain capabilities. It holds B-level certification in Nissan's global supplier system and maintains high-quality standards comparable to Japanese manufacturing practices. The company emphasizes differentiation through innovation, quality, and global operational capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2024 revenue of 1.332 billion yuan, representing 40.17% growth compared to 2023 revenue of 950.24 million yuan. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 97.65 million yuan in 2024, up 16.05% from 84.15 million yuan in 2023. Total assets reached 1.965 billion yuan at year-end 2024 compared to 1.835 billion yuan in 2023. The company demonstrates strong growth trajectory with revenue expanding from 693.3 million yuan in 2022. New energy vehicle business revenue reached 444.06 million yuan in 2024, representing 38.29% of total revenue and growing 49.61% year-over-year, indicating accelerating growth in this strategic segment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) integrated solution capabilities spanning design, mold development, manufacturing, coating, wrapping and assembly; (2) advanced manufacturing technologies including intelligent injection molding and automated coating systems; (3) precision quality standards meeting international OEM requirements, evidenced by Nissan B-level certification; (4) innovation in smart interior components including touch-sensitive surfaces and integrated lighting; (5) lightweight and environmentally-friendly material solutions; (6) global supply chain network enabling local service to international customers; (7) synchronized development capability allowing rapid response to customer platform development cycles; (8) strong R&D capabilities with 219 authorized patents and continuous technology advancement in areas like low-pressure injection molding and modular design.
